configurePresets.name: vs-base
configurePresets.description: Settings shared by both build.ps1 passes: the Visual Studio generator build.ps1 gets by default (it passes -A but no -G), and Release, build.ps1's default -mode. CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE is inert for the multi-config VS generator but mirrors build.ps1's -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE. CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 lets CMake >= 4 configure the FetchContent deps (minhook, protopuf, argparse, spdlog) that still declare cmake_minimum_required(< 3.5); it mirrors build.ps1:26,28.

configurePresets.name: x64
configurePresets.description: Full 64-bit pass, mirroring build.ps1 -arch x64 (build.ps1:26,32): -A x64 into build/x64. Builds proxinjectee.dll, proxinjector (GUI) and proxinjector-cli.

configurePresets.name: win32-injectee-only
configurePresets.description: 32-bit injectee pass, mirroring the second half of build.ps1 -arch x64 (build.ps1:20,28,34): -A Win32 -DPROXINJECTEE_ONLY=ON into build/Win32. Yields build/Win32/Release/proxinjectee.dll, which build.ps1:41 ships as release/proxinjectee32.dll, plus wow64-address-dumper.exe (build.ps1:42).

buildPresets.name: win32-injectee-only
buildPresets.description: Equivalent to: cmake --build build/Win32 --config Release (build.ps1:34). Run it together with the 'x64' build preset to reproduce a full ./build.ps1 -mode Release -arch x64 run.
